# QuickLook Next

QuickLook Next is an open-source Windows file preview application built with WinUI 3, Rust, and isolated helper processes.

- [Project website](https://sherlockchiang.github.io/QuickLook.Next/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/SherlockChiang/QuickLook.Next)
- [Latest releases](https://github.com/SherlockChiang/QuickLook.Next/releases/latest)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/SherlockChiang/QuickLook.Next/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
